defaults.document_bound: One section, worksheet, or semantic category per chunk; split dynamically when needed.
defaults.completion_gate: Persist and validate outputs, cite evidence, record uncertainty, and publish a checkpoint before advancing.
defaults.next_chunk_rule: First incomplete eligible chunk in the sequence; a permission blocker stops execution until resolved. Record the exact next ID at closure.
